name: Mitten Extracts 510 Cartridge | Purple Punch
description: This Indica dominant classic is a cross between Larry OG and Granddaddy Purple. Known for its strong scent of grape candy, blueberry muffins, and tart Kool-Aid, this potent combination will give the consumer a one-two punch to the head and body. Its effects may help with managing nausea, stress, minor body aches, and sleeplessness.
